content:
lia: Hey support — customer (sam@acme.com, acct_01Gxxxx) can't start free trial. Flow stops at payment step: UI shows "Payment method required" and 3DS spinner then an error. Ticket #12345. Can we escalate?

kevin: Can you paste the payment gateway response / logs?

lia: pasted below (from staging repro):
```
{
  \"id\": \"pi_1Kxxxx\",
  \"status\": \"requires_action\",
  \"next_action\": {
    \"type\": \"use_challenge\",
    \"three_d_secure\": {
      \"status\": \"challenge_required\",
      \"attempts_remaining\": 0
    }
  },
  \"error\": {
    \"type\": \"3ds_challenge_timeout\",
    \"message\": \"Challenge timeout after 120s\"
  }
}
```

payments-bot: automated note — payment confirm failed for acct_01Gxxxx: code=CHALLENGE_TIMEOUT, retry_count=1, proxied_by=stripe-proxy-03

jordan: Looks like the gateway returned requires_action and then the 3DS challenge timed out. Could be iframe timing or proxy retry policy. Is this consistent across cards?

lia: I tried two cards (Visa, Amex) in staging; both hit the same timeout on the integrated challenge iframe. However the separate Billing > Add card flow (hosted popup) succeeds. Customer can't finish onboarding because we require card-on-file to activate trial.

sre_oncall: Checking metrics — stripe-proxy p95 spiked to ~600ms around 2026-03-16T14:22Z. No obvious global outage but retries were higher.

kevin: We need to get the customer into a trial ASAP. Lia, confirm credits and duration you want me to grant manually. Also leaving an audit note.

lia: Please grant 100 trial credits (equivalent to 14 days for starter) and mark as manual override with reason "3DS timeout". Customer is blocked for onboarding.

kevin: Running internal tool now:
```
/grant_trial_credits --acct acct_01Gxxxx --email sam@acme.com --credits 100 --expires 2026-03-30 --reason \"3DS timeout - manual grant by kevin\"
```

payments-bot: Command result: SUCCESS, txn_id=tx_8Yz9, granted_by=kevin, timestamp=2026-03-16T14:35:12Z

lia: Customer confirmed the trial is active and can call the API. They reported they were able to finish onboarding after we granted credits. :white_check_mark:

jordan: Filed ENG-4567 to investigate: increase proxy retry on challenge flows, add telemetry for 3DS challenge durations, and consider fallback to hosted add-card flow when integrated iframe times out.

sre_oncall: Adding a short-term alert on stripe-proxy 3DS latency > 500ms to catch regressions.

lia: I'll follow up with the customer and close the ticket after verification. Thanks all.

kevin: Leaving audit entry and will add a support tag so ops/product can track frequency.

lia: Closing loop — customer onboarded. Will post summary to #support-daily. :thumbsup:
